references.text: God speaks to Abram and says "Do not be afraid", the same comforting words the Lord gives to Gideon
The Lord reveals Himself to Isaac and says "Do not be afraid", the same message of divine protection
God speaks to Jacob in a vision and says "Do not be afraid", the same assurance of God's presence and protection
Moses tells the people "Do not be afraid" after meeting with God at Sinai, a similar context of divine revelation
God says that no one can see His face and live, providing background for Gideon's fear of dying
Manoah and his wife also fear they will die after seeing the angel of the Lord, and receive similar assurance
Isaiah fears for his life after seeing the Lord, the same fear that Gideon experienced
"Do not be afraid, for I am with you" - God's assurance of peace and protection
A heavenly messenger says "Peace be with you" and "Do not be afraid" to Daniel, the same comforting words
The angel tells Zechariah "Do not be afraid", the same divine assurance at a revelation
The angel tells Mary "Do not be afraid", a similar situation with a heavenly messenger bringing peace
Jesus says "Do not be afraid" to John after his overwhelming vision, the same pattern as with Gideon
